description_for_human: Port congestion, ETA delay, freight volatility and demurrage estimates for 19 global ports. Santos (BRSSZ), Paranaguá (BRPNG), Rio de Janeiro (BRRIO), Niterói (BRNIT) and Itaguaí (BRITG) use LIVE Brazilian line-ups; the rest use a reference seed.
description_for_model: Returns congestion signals for ports. Call GET /v1/port-risk with a UN/LOCODE port_id (e.g. BRSSZ for Santos, BRPNG for Paranaguá, BRRIO for Rio de Janeiro, BRNIT for Niterói, BRITG for Itaguaí, CNSHA for Shanghai, NLRTM for Rotterdam) to get congestion_score (0-1), eta_delay_days, waiting_vessels, freight_volatility_index and estimated_daily_demurrage_usd. Every response includes data_source (for BRSSZ/BRPNG: 'live:appa+santos+lachmann' from APPA Paranaguá, Porto de Santos operations panel and Lachmann schedules; BRRIO/BRNIT/BRITG: 'live:portosrio_silog' from SILOG PortosRio; otherwise 'static_reference_seed'), plus as_of. Call GET /v1/port-trend for the 24h/48h/72h congestion projection with a trend label (acelerando, estável, descongestionando). IMPORTANT: seed values are reference baselines, NOT real-time telemetry; the trend is a synthetic projection. Unknown ports fall back to a global estimate with country='Global'. Signals are provided AS IS and are not investment advice.
